name: Project monorepo devcontainer
postCreateCommand: git config --global commit.gpgsign false; git config --local core.pager "less -R"; pnpm install; sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y debian-keyring debian-archive-keyring apt-transport-https && curl -1sLf 'https://dl.cloudsmith.io/public/caddy/stable/gpg.key' | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/caddy-stable-archive-keyring.gpg && curl -1sLf 'https://dl.cloudsmith.io/public/caddy/stable/debian.deb.txt' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/caddy-stable.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y caddy && sudo setcap 'cap_net_bind_service=+ep' /usr/bin/caddy && echo '127.0.0.1 myapp.com' | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts
